Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust (BXDC) has signed a definitive agreement to acquire a 75 percent majority interest in two joint ventures with Amazon Web Services (AWS), in a transaction valued at approximately $5 billion reflecting an initial capitalization rate of 7.0 percent. The transaction represents BXDC’s inaugural investment and advances its strategy of acquiring and owning high-quality, stabilized data centers leased to leading cloud provider customers on long-term contracts.

The joint ventures will own 13 newly constructed powered shells across two AWS data center campuses, with AWS retaining a 25 percent interest in the joint ventures. AWS will lease back 100 percent of the portfolio on a triple-net basis with an initial lease term of 12 years and a fully extended lease term of 32 years.
